purpose: Preregister a smaller untouched-family transfer experiment after the frozen n=20 portfolio holdout exceeded the current Python hard timeout. This is a new protocol with new graph instances; it does not alter or reinterpret the incomplete n=20 holdout.
formula: Positive monotone graph 2-CNF: conjunction over edges (x_u OR x_v).
compiler: Fresh reduced ordered BDD compiler per candidate using exact Shannon restriction of the monotone CNF. Correctness oracle is exhaustive full assignment truth bitset plus Hamming-weight rank vector for each family. No candidate-compilation cache may be shared across policy cells.

local_search.candidate_filter: compile only candidates with vertex-separation width <= current_width + 1
local_search.selection: minimum final live ROBDD nodes, then minimum allocated nodes, then lexicographic order

seeded_diverse.choice: among eligible random permutations, maximize the minimum normalized inversion/Kendall distance to natural and reverse_cuthill_mckee; ties by lower width then lexicographic order; if none eligible choose the random candidate with minimum width then lexicographic order

policies.single_rcm3: Run reverse_cuthill_mckee arm up to 3 accepted moves; return its endpoint.
policies.single_natural3: Run natural arm up to 3 accepted moves; return its endpoint.
policies.two_arm_one_then_commit: Run one accepted-move search stage from reverse_cuthill_mckee and natural independently, select lower live-node arm with ties by lower charged candidate compilations then RCM priority, then continue only winner to at most 3 accepted moves total.
policies.three_arm_one_then_commit: As two-arm one-then-commit but include seeded_diverse, with fixed tie priority RCM, natural, seeded_diverse.
policies.full_two_arm3: Run RCM and natural independently up to 3 accepted moves each and return the better endpoint; pay both arms.

cost_accounting.primary_cost: candidate ROBDD compilations actually paid, including losing arms
cost_accounting.reporting: Report per-family quality/cost, normalized live regret to full_two_arm3, and cost ratio. A portfolio is beneficial only if it improves live nodes at explicit finite extra cost or matches live nodes with fewer compilations.

resource_guard.on_guard: mark incomplete and exclude that cell from Pareto/transfer claims

predeclared_tests: All completed policy endpoints must reproduce the same exhaustive truth bitset and Hamming-weight rank vector for the family.
Primary transfer comparison is three_arm_one_then_commit versus full_two_arm3; two_arm_one_then_commit is a secondary ablation.
Report whether seeded_diverse changes any committed arm or endpoint, including losses.
Do not treat vertex-separation width as an authoritative value function.
Do not combine this smaller holdout with the incomplete n=20 holdout as if they were one preregistered test.
No endpoint is a global variable-order optimum and no result is a CUDD dynamic-reordering benchmark.
scope: Five new small graph families/instances selected before outcomes to test transfer of the charged start-portfolio controller under the current runtime budget. Synthetic monotone simple-game certifier only; no claim about nonmonotone finite-compute proof utility.
